responsibilities: Pipeline & Modeling Support: Assist in writing and optimizing SQL queries and dbt models to clean and transform raw regional data in BigQuery
Dashboard Development: Assist in maintaining our Looker (LookML) code and building high-performance, customized dashboards for our boutique networks
Data Quality Assurance: Build automated data quality test to monitor data anomalies and our regional data pipeline performance to ensure our analytical products maintain 100% data accuracy
Platform Migration & Modernization: Actively assist in documenting and migrating legacy reporting systems into our unified, cloud-based GCP platform
Data Governance & Documentation: Standardize regional KPI definitions, engage with key stakeholders and maintain clear, structured data documentation to foster a strong regional data community

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Data Quality Assurance: Build automated data quality test to monitor data anomalies and our regional data pipeline performance to ensure our analytical products maintain 100% data accuracy
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Quality controls dominate the task list — automated tests, anomaly monitoring and "100% data accuracy" — and no speed or shipping language appears.
evidence.domain_risk: building high-performance, customized dashboards for our boutique networks
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Output feeds retail reporting for "our boutique networks" with no financial-reporting, regulatory or audit language anywhere, so errors affect business decisions rather than filings.
evidence.collaboration_width: No distinctly named partner teams; the JD refers only to generic "key stakeholders" and "diverse business stakeholders across different markets"
evidence.data_team_maturity: Platform Migration & Modernization: Actively assist in documenting and migrating legacy reporting systems into our unified, cloud-based GCP platform
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A GCP platform, Looker code and legacy reporting systems already exist and are named in the responsibilities, but the estate is mid-migration rather than established at scale.
evidence.jd_authorship: Pipeline & Modeling Support: Assist in writing and optimizing SQL queries and dbt models to clean and transform raw regional data in BigQuery
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Each bullet names the specific tool and what it is used on — dbt models in BigQuery, LookML for boutique dashboards, migration off legacy reporting — so the intern's actual tasks are legible.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Data Governance & Documentation: Standardize regional KPI definitions, engage with key stakeholders and maintain clear, structured data documentation to foster a strong regional data community
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Three of five responsibilities are platform-side — pipelines, migration, governance and documentation "to foster a strong regional data community" — with only the dashboard bullet pointing at a business audience.
evidence.autonomy_level: Assist in writing and optimizing SQL queries and dbt models to clean and transform raw regional data in BigQuery
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Four of five bullets begin with "Assist in" or "Actively assist in", so the work is scoped and handed down rather than directed by the role.
evidence.ai_role: Intermediate coding/scripting skills in Python (highly preferred for pipeline automation and AI integration)
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The one AI reference asks for scripting skill to serve "pipeline automation and AI integration", placing the candidate's output upstream of AI rather than asking them to code with AI assistance; it is a single hedged requirement-side phrase, not a responsibility.
evidence.testing_framing: Build automated data quality test to monitor data anomalies and our regional data pipeline performance
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing is a named responsibility with the action verb "Build", not a tool sitting in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: to ensure our analytical products maintain 100% data accuracy
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Accuracy and pipeline anomalies are an explicit concern but the fear is data failures rather than compliance exposure or lost stakeholder trust, and no regulatory language appears.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Actively assist in documenting and migrating legacy reporting systems into our unified, cloud-based GCP platform
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The infrastructure verbs are migrate, maintain and optimize against existing systems — nothing is described as built from scratch.
evidence.language_gate: Languages: Fluency in English is required; proficiency in Chinese (Cantonese and/or Mandarin) is an advantage.
evidence.loss_aversion: Risk framing is operational: "Build automated data quality test to monitor data anomalies and our regional data pipeline performance to ensure our analytical products maintain 100% data accuracy" — reliability of the pipeline, with no compliance or audit framing.
evidence.role_anomaly: Non-standard role: this is a fixed-term internship ("Must be currently enrolled in university and eligible for a full-time 6-month internship in Hong Kong"), mapped to seniority junior as the best fit since the corpus has no intern level. Duties are assistive versions of standard analytics-engineering tasks.
